source_attribution: Reyes-Ortiz, Anguita, Ghio, Oneto and Parra (2013), UCI HAR, DOI10.24432/C54S4K. Derived native window-fingerprint memory task; not HAR activity classification.

independence.unit: one training subject paired with one disjoint evaluation subject and one predetermined original source-fit unit; CI over five pairs, never windows/queries

intake.other_subjects: Read public subject IDs and archive bytes/hashes only; skip signal rows without numeric conversion or arrays. No unselected target examples or labels printed/inspected. Acquisition is a visible local sealed archive, not an externally blinded final.
intake.failure: Preserve intake failure with hashes/costs; no model fit or paid registration, no data-guided recipe change. Choose a separately preregistered alternative if infeasible.

native_observation.features: For each of six physical channels compute eight consecutive block means (eight selected samples each). Add eight means of triaxial body-acceleration magnitude and eight means of triaxial gyro magnitude. Concatenate channel-major 8x8 =64. No arbitrary orthogonal projection, PVM latent identities or Gaussian resynthesis.
native_observation.adverse_query: Advance query indices by two original samples, clipping at127; set gyro_y to zero before block means and recompute gyro magnitude. Same windows, random truth, handles and update schedule as nominal.
native_observation.normalization: Mean and standard deviation per coordinate fitted on the128 T-fit WRITE features only; floor std1e-6. Apply same scalar map to all write/query views, then per-vector L2 normalize with floor1e-12. Fit statistics and every copy/transform charged. No dev/final statistic.

training_partition.dev_nonoverlap: Subject encounter order, keep every second row;128-sample windows/50% overlap. Independent variation is subject, not retained windows.
training_partition.pair_draws: Within fixed T subset, deterministic paired resampling with replacement; unique rows counted and exposed. Repeated4096 pairs are not4096 independent observations.

episodes.scale_justification: Finite per-subject independent physical windows; maximum requires64 stored plus16 absent. Three scales span4x; no K512 or broad scaling-law claim.
episodes.queries: Known drawn with replacement from stored windows; sixteen absent windows sampled without replacement from the same subject outside stored set. Query exposes only native64float32 observation.
episodes.facts: Random0..15 payload attached legally to each observed native record; timestamp/handle/observation/value/source_id are supplied identically to all arms. Update payload changes modulo16 by a nonzero increment; source_id changes to that actual public write version.
episodes.writes: Native key view unchanged across versions; overwrite only later timestamp; deliberately stale write after current update must be ignored.
episodes.source_id: Public originating UCI subject/window/version identifier on each write, withheld from query. Candidate must return source of selected current fact. Hand-written latest-write logic disclosed and charged; not learned reasoning.
episodes.calibration_condition: nominal only; no adverse/dev threshold selection
episodes.seed_policy: Five audited runner-random model/episode seeds, all outcomes, no replacement; source unit fixed by index. Episode sampling does not create new physical datasets.

source_evidence.policy: Restore actual state i for target unit i. Never replay source fit or choose a favorable source unit. Frozen source encoder and PCA/weights verified before/after target adaptation. Identical bounded ridge output-adapter/calibration granted to all source arms. Target adapter alone is not transfer; primary source-information contrasts mandatory.

cost_boundary.service: Raw native episode input copy and64-feature construction/scaling, all per-record/per-query copies, state loading from validated parameter arrays, allocation, ingest/latest-write/index/cache, updates, warmup, single-query synchronized inference, threshold/output/source decode and Python outputs. Report disjoint components; update subset not double counted.
cost_boundary.offline: Archive download/decompression/numeric intake/subject routing, train scaler, source file loading/validation, all readout/target fits/grids/calibration/tests/failures charged and disclosed; R1/R4/R16 =full fixed condition workload with actual offline cost included once.
cost_boundary.memory: Logical numeric state including encoder/readout/PCA/record/source/time/index/cache and serialized fitted bytes; sampled process-tree RSS; cumulative trusted CUDA allocator/reserved peaks when available. No energy or total physical VRAM claim.
cost_boundary.latency: batch1 end-to-end p50/p95 actual query samples; all warmup/copies decoded outputs included in complete workload. Native feature parser explicitly timed. SameCPUthreads1,FP32 service/FP64 linear fits; CUDA target training only.
